svg.title: LogisticPilot — Evidence-led fulfillment architecture
svg.desc: Static architecture diagram showing declared synthetic demo inputs flowing through the Operations UI, Python coordinator, deterministic gate, and bounded ERPNext actions with readback. A Strands agent on Bedrock Claude Opus 4.6 advises the coordinator. Airtable, Jira, Celigo, Slack, and a retained readback journal are shown as handoff evidence. Historical PO20 execution, current retained review mode, and separate historical AgentCore proof are clearly separated.

g.text: Agent advises · deterministic application owns effects
From evidence to checked ERP records
source mode stays visible at every step

g.aria-label: Declared demo inputs: count, lot, inspection, carrier; synthetic
Python coordinator: case state, evidence journal, application control
Deterministic gate: evidence, quantity, case and revision, operator approval
ERPNext: bounded native actions and authoritative readback
Strands agent on Bedrock Claude Opus 4.6: advisory contract option and read-only Q and A
Connected handoffs and retained readback journal
g.text: The coordinator journals connected evidence after each bounded route
source links and statuses stay inspectable

g.aria-label: Airtable: case record and lot disposition
Celigo: single-attempt import and correlated run receipt
Slack: human operating context and verified notification
Retained readback journal: provider link, status and timestamp
g.text: provider link · status · timestamp · source mode

g.aria-label: Historical PO20 native demo execution: 40 received and dispatched, A25 and B15, delivery confirmations synthetic
g.text: 40 received / dispatched · A25 / B15 · delivery synthetic

g.aria-label: Current review mode: retained source snapshot, real Opus answers, fresh operations disabled
g.text: Retained source snapshot · real Opus answers

g.aria-label: AgentCore separately proven historically and not the current application path
g.text: Read-only deployment evidence · not current path
